text:
Ali: Quick follow-up from last night's ACME dedicated outage. Main culprits: VPC peering flaps + the on‑prem isolation bug we saw. Need to lock owners/timelines for remediation and a cadence to detect recurrence.
Marta: ok, high level first — I can own the VPC peering hardening work. ETA for a concrete plan by EOD Friday. :white_check_mark:
Jason: I can take the on‑prem isolation bug (it was the namespace leak with the FW rule). Will triage root cause and post a short repro. ETA Tuesday morning.
Tia: I'll drive changes to the postmortem runbook and add a dedicated checklist for Dedicated/Private customers (VPC peering sanity, external route validation, onprem firewall validation). Target next-week PR.
Samir: FYI infra-bot already ran a quick scan and found 2 peers with flapping history in the last 7d. infra-bot: scan report: peers/flap_count: acme-peer-1/5, acme-peer-3/3.
Ali: Good catch — Samir, can you add a temporary routing alert (pager) for >3 flaps in 1h for customer peers? Owner: Samir, ETA today.
Samir: Will do. I'll add an alert with a 15m dedupe window and a runbook link.
Marta: For VPC peering hardening: proposed steps:
- audit all peering configs for TTL/keepalive mismatches
- bump BFD keepalive to 3s where supported
- add peer-level circuit health metric export to our console
I'll draft the audit checklist and share by Friday.
Jason: On the on‑prem isolation bug: initial suspicion is the agent's network namespace cleanup race when a local kube-proxy restarts. Repro snippet I'm using:
```
# repro (approx)
kubectl delete pod app-proxy -n customer-acme
# then simulate kube-proxy restart on node
systemctl restart kube-proxy
# observe missing routes on host namespace
ip route show | grep 10.0.0.0/16
```
I will confirm and propose a hotfix (ensuring agent rebind on kube-proxy change).
Tia: We should also add a QA test that simulates peer flap + kube-proxy restart together — this looks like a recurring pattern: peering instability + local agent bug -> customer isolation.
Ali: Agreed. Action items so far: 
- Marta: VPC peering audit + hardening plan (ETA Fri)
- Jason: on‑prem repro + hotfix proposal (ETA Tue)
- Samir: routing flap alert + runbook link (ETA today)
- Tia: runbook + QA test for combined failure mode (ETA next-week PR)
Please include PR numbers in this thread when opened.
Marta: One more thing — we should schedule a customer touchpoint with ACME to explain remediation timeline. I'll coordinate with CS after we have the plan.
Jason: If hotfix is low risk we can ship a staged rollout to Dedicated clusters and offer ACME an earlier patch build.
Samir: infra-bot: created alert rule id=alert-7834, channel=#oncall, dedupe=15m.
Ali: Thanks. Also let's add a recurring 2-week postmortem follow-up check (30m) for the next 2 months to watch for regressions. Tia, can you add calendar invites?
Tia: Yep — will add invites for the triage cadence recurring every 2 weeks for 8 weeks.
Marta: Posting tentative timeline in thread: audit done by Fri -> hardening PR by next Wed -> deploy to staging next Thu -> monitor 2 weeks -> deploy to prod after clean run.
Jason: I'll prioritize the repro and try to have a patch by Tue EOD. If I hit blockers I'll DM Ali.
Ali: Nice. Let's keep updates short in this thread: PR links, alert IDs, customer sync notes. Thanks everyone. :heart:
infra-bot: incident-tracker: linked postmortem id=pm-2026-03-acme-dedicated to this thread.
